slot.brief: Brown ring test: ask which ion is confirmed and the formula of the coloured complex responsible

stem: A sample is known to contain no nitrite. In the brown ring test, which ion and coloured complex correspond to a positive result?

verdicts.working: With nitrite absent, a positive brown ring test indicates nitrate. The brown nitrosyl complex is [Fe(H₂O)₅(NO)]²⁺.

working:
With nitrite absent, a positive brown ring test confirms $\text{NO}_3^-$. \\
Coloured complex: $[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5(\text{NO})]^{2+}$.

Independent check: With nitrite absent, a positive brown ring test indicates nitrate. The brown nitrosyl complex is [Fe(H₂O)₅(NO)]²⁺.
solution: With nitrite absent, a positive brown ring test indicates nitrate ions, $\text{NO}_3^-$. The brown ring is due to the complex $[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5(\text{NO})]^{2+}$.
